middleware.title: IPTV Middleware
middleware.text: The beating heart of your platform. Manage subscribers, subscriptions, devices and entitlements across every app and set-top box.

live.title: Live TV & Multicast
live.text: Ultra-fast channel switching, pause-live-TV and catch-up built on proven HLS/DASH delivery for rock-solid streams.

vod.text: Curated libraries, categories, rental windows and series management with automatic transcoding and poster artwork.

faq.q1: Can I migrate from another platform?
faq.a1: Yes. Our migration team imports subscribers, line-ups, VOD libraries and EPG data from all major IPTV panels — typically within one business week and at no extra cost for Growth plans and above.
faq.q2: Do you charge per channel or per subscriber?
faq.a2: Neither. Plans are based on active subscribers, and channel count is unlimited on Growth and Enterprise. You will never pay a per-channel tax for growing your line-up.
faq.q3: Is the platform really available in six languages?
faq.a3: Yes — English, German, Turkish, Chinese, Spanish and Russian, for both the admin panel and the end-user apps. More languages can be added per request.
faq.q4: What happens when I outgrow my plan?
faq.a4: Upgrades apply instantly and pro-rata. Many operators start on Starter and move to Growth within the first quarter — your data, line-ups and apps carry over untouched.

docs.subtitle: Everything you need to operate, integrate and extend StreamHive.

lines.title: Lines Management
lines.short: Create, monitor and troubleshoot every subscriber line.
lines.long: The Lines module is where operators spend most of their day. It provides instant search across millions of lines, bulk actions for common tasks and per-line diagnostics showing connection quality, device history and stream usage.
bullets: Instant search over millions of lines
Bulk enable, disable, extend and move

vod.title: VOD & Series
vod.short: Libraries, categories, artwork and rental logic.
vod.long: Upload once, publish everywhere. The VOD module ingests source files, triggers the transcoding ladder, fetches artwork and metadata, and publishes to categories and series — with rental windows and pricing if you sell content.
bullets: Import from FTP, S3 and RSS feeds

epg.title: EPG & Metadata
epg.short: Multi-language programme guides and catch-up archives.
epg.long: The EPG module maps XMLTV and Gracenote feeds to your line-up, normalises genres across providers and publishes a 14-day guide in every supported language. Catch-up archives are built automatically from the live stream.

clients.title: Apps & Devices
clients.short: Publish apps to stores and manage device fleets.
clients.long: Ship native apps without a mobile team. The Clients module builds white-label apps from your branding, submits them to stores on your behalf and tracks every installed device — with remote kill-switch for stolen STBs.
bullets: White-label builds for Android, iOS and Smart TV

billing.title: Billing
billing.long: The Billing module turns entitlements into revenue. Define packages with trials and promotions, collect payment through Stripe or local methods, issue invoices in the customer's language and automate dunning for failed renewals.
bullets: Packages with trials, promos and stacking

security.title: Security
security.long: Security protects both content and trust. The Security module wraps streams in Widevine, PlayReady and FairPlay, fingerprints traffic for leak detection and keeps an audit trail of every privileged action in the panel.
bullets: SSO, 2FA and IP policies for staff
Full audit trail of panel actions

intro.p: By accessing or using the StreamHive platform you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws. If you do not agree with any part of the terms, you may not use the service.

service.p: StreamHive provides IPTV/OTT content management software on a subscription basis. Features and capacity depend on the plan purchased. We may improve or modify the service continuously and without prior notice.

accounts.p: Operators are responsible for the legality of distributed content in their territory, for their subscribers' activities, and for keeping account credentials secure. Account sharing of panel access is prohibited.

billing.p: Subscriptions renew automatically each period until cancelled. Cancellations take effect at the end of the paid period. Overdue accounts enter a grace period, after which service is suspended.

what.p: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. We use them to remember your language and appearance preferences and to understand aggregated traffic on our website.

which.p: sh_lang remembers your chosen interface language. sh_mode and sh_accent remember your dark/light and colour preferences. All of them are first-party, optional and expire within one year.

control.p: You can clear these cookies at any time through your browser settings. Doing so resets language and appearance preferences to their defaults without affecting site functionality.
